questions.text: In a certain code language, 'PLANT' is written as 'OKZMG'. How will 'FARMER' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Compare positions. P(16)->O(15) = -1. L(12)->K(11) = -1. A(1)->Z(26) = -1 (wrap around). N(14)->M(13) = -1. T(20)->S(19) = -1. Pattern: Each letter shifted -1 (Previous letter). Apply to FARMER: F->E, A->Z, R->Q, M->L, E->D, R->Q. Result: EZQLDQ. Full Solution: Verify each letter: F(6)-1=E(5), A(1)-1=Z(26), R(18)-1=Q(17), M(13)-1=L(12), E(5)-1=D(4), R(18)-1=Q(17). Matches Option A.

questions.text: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence: "The committee has approved the new policy."

options.label: A
options.text: The new policy is approved by the committee.

options.label: B
options.text: The new policy has been approved by the committee.

options.label: C
options.text: The new policy was approved by the committee.

options.label: D
options.text: The new policy has approved by the committee.

questions.solution: Shortcut: For Present Perfect Active (has/have + V3), the passive structure is Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject. Step-by-step: The active sentence is in Present Perfect tense ('has approved'). The object 'the new policy' becomes the passive subject. The verb changes to 'has been approved' (has/have + been + V3). The original subject 'the committee' becomes the agent introduced by 'by'.

questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech for the given sentence: He said, "I am writing a letter now."

options.label: A
options.text: He said that he is writing a letter now.

options.label: B
options.text: He said that he wrote a letter then.

options.label: C
options.text: He said that he was writing a letter then.

options.label: D
options.text: He said that he has written a letter now.

questions.solution: Shortcut: When the reporting verb is past ('said'), Present Continuous ('am writing') shifts to Past Continuous ('was writing') and 'now' changes to 'then'. Step-by-step: The reporting verb 'said' remains unchanged. The pronoun 'I' changes to 'he' (matching the subject of reporting verb). The tense backshifts: 'am writing' (Present Continuous) becomes 'was writing' (Past Continuous). The time adverb 'now' changes to 'then' to reflect the past perspective.

questions.text: Which of the following is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?

options.label: A
options.text: To act as the banker, agent, and advisor to the Government of India

options.label: B
options.text: To serve as the central bank for foreign banks only

options.label: C
options.text: To regulate the prices of agricultural commodities exclusively

options.label: D
options.text: To issue currency notes for private commercial entities

questions.solution: The primary function of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is to act as the banker, agent, and advisor to the Government of India, manage foreign reserves, and regulate the banking system. Options B, C, and D are incorrect because the RBI's scope extends beyond just foreign banks or commodities, and it does not issue currency for private entities; note issuance is a sovereign function managed by the RBI on behalf of the government.

questions.text: From an external point P, a tangent PT and a secant PAB are drawn to a circle. If PT = 12 cm and PA = 8 cm, find the length of chord AB.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Tangent-Secant Theorem: PT² = PA × PB. 12² = 8 × PB → PB = 144/8 = 18 cm. Chord AB = PB - PA = 18 - 8 = 10 cm. Full: By the Tangent-Secant theorem, the square of the length of the tangent segment equals the product of the lengths of the whole secant segment and its external segment. So, PT² = PA × PB. Substituting values: 144 = 8 × PB ⇒ PB = 18 cm. The chord AB is the internal part of the secant, so AB = PB - PA = 18 - 8 = 10 cm.

questions.text: 'Heart' is related to 'Cardiology' in the same way as 'Kidney' is related to '______'.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Identify the relationship 'Organ : Branch of Medicine'. Cardiology is the study of the Heart. The branch for Kidney is Nephrology. Eliminate Neurology (nerves), Oncology (cancer), Dermatology (skin). Step-by-step: The first word is the primary organ treated by the medical specialty in the second word. Cardiology deals with the heart; similarly, Nephrology deals with the kidneys.

questions.text: Which of the following gases is primarily responsible for the greenhouse effect in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.solution: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is the primary greenhouse gas emitted through human activities like burning fossil fuels. Nitrogen and Oxygen make up most of the atmosphere but are not significant greenhouse gases. Helium is an inert noble gas with negligible atmospheric concentration or heat-trapping ability.

questions.text: Who chaired the Fifteenth Finance Commission of India, constituted for the award period 2021-2026?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 14th FC (2015-20) = Y.V. Reddy (42% devolution); 15th FC (2021-26) = N.K. Singh (41% devolution). Worked Solution: The Fifteenth Finance Commission was constituted in November 2017 under the chairmanship of N.K. Singh. Its recommendations cover the six-year period from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2026. It recommended a vertical tax devolution of 41% to states, slightly lower than the 42% recommended by the 14th FC chaired by Y.V. Reddy.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of the expression (7^95 - 3^58)?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Cyclicity of 4): Unit digit of powers repeats every 4. For 7^95: 95 mod 4 = 3 → 7^3 = 343 → Unit digit 3. For 3^58: 58 mod 4 = 2 → 3^2 = 9 → Unit digit 9. Unit digit of (3 - 9) = Unit digit of (-6) = 4 (borrowing 10). Step-by-step: Cyclicity of 7 is 7, 9, 3, 1. 95 = 4×23 + 3 → 3rd position → 3. Cyclicity of 3 is 3, 9, 7, 1. 58 = 4×14 + 2 → 2nd position → 9. Difference = 3 - 9 = -6. Since unit digit cannot be negative, add 10 → 10 - 6 = 4.

questions.text: Find the unit digit of the expression \((127)^{153} + (248)^{206} + (369)^{112}\).
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use cyclicity of unit digits. For 7: cycle 4 (7,9,3,1), 153%4=1 → 7. For 8: cycle 4 (8,4,2,6), 206%4=2 → 4. For 9: cycle 2 (9,1), 112%2=0 → 1. Sum = 7+4+1=12 → unit digit 2. Full: Unit digit of 127^153 = 7^153. Cyclicity of 7 is 4; 153 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 1, so unit digit is 7. Unit digit of 248^206 = 8^206. Cyclicity of 8 is 4; 206 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 2, so unit digit is 4. Unit digit of 369^112 = 9^112. Cyclicity of 9 is 2; 112 ÷ 2 leaves remainder 0, so unit digit is 1. Sum of unit digits = 7 + 4 + 1 = 12. Required unit digit is 2.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'LOGIC' is written as 'MNHJD'. How will 'REASON' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe the alternating pattern of +1 and -1 in alphabetical positions (L+1=M, O-1=N, G+1=H, I-1=J, C+1=D). Apply the same pattern to REASON: R+1=S, E-1=D, A+1=B, S-1=R, O+1=P, N-1=M. Step-by-step: The pattern holds for all 5 letters of LOGIC. Applying it to the 6 letters of REASON yields SDBRPM.

questions.text: Which article of the Constitution of India deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.solution: Article 32 of the Constitution of India guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies, allowing citizens to move the Supreme Court for the enforcement of their fundamental rights. Article 19 deals with freedom of speech and other freedoms, Article 21 protects life and personal liberty, and Article 44 pertains to the Uniform Civil Code; thus, options A, B, and D are incorrect.

questions.text: If a % b = a² - band a % b = 63, find a and b.
questions.solution: Given: If a % b = a² - band a % b = 63 Now, we check each options. Option (a): 9, 6 9 - 6= 81 - 36 = 45 63 Option (b): 10, 7 10 - 7 = 100 - 49 = 51 63 Option (c): 8, 1 8 - 1 = 64 - 1 = 63 Option (d): 7, 4 7 - 4 = 49 - 16 = 33 63 So, the value of a = 8 and b = 1. Thus, correct option is (c).2 2= 2 2= 2 2 2 2 =

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells rice at a discount of 6% on the marked price but uses a weight that is 25% less than the actual weight. Find his overall profit percentage.
questions.solution: Given: Discount=6% Weight used=25% less Formula Used: Profit %= ×Cost PriceProfit100 Solution: Let marked price of 1 kg rice=100 Selling price after discount=100−6=94 Actual weight given=75% =0.75 Cost price of 0.75 kg=75 Profit=94−75=19 Profit %= ×7519100 =25.33%

questions.text: Choose the word that best substitutes the given group of words: A person who loves and collects books
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use Greek root elimination. 'Biblio' = books (Bible), 'phile' = lover. 'Philately' = stamps, 'Numisma' = coins, 'Cartography' = maps. Only Option A matches 'books + lover'. Full Solution: A Bibliophile is a lover/collector of books. A Philatelist collects stamps. A Numismatist collects coins/currency. A Cartographer draws maps. The definition matches Bibliophile exactly.
